description: This file defines the class 'SQLitePersistentStoreBackendBase' which manages initialization, schema migration, and transaction handling for a SQLite database within the Chromium project. It includes methods for database setup, migration, committing operations, and error handling, and is intended to be subclassed for specific database implementations.

classes.name: SQLitePersistentStoreBackendBase
classes.description: A reference-counted base class that manages the lifecycle, schema, and transaction operations of a SQLite database, designed for subclassing to implement specific database behaviors within Chromium.

methods.name: Flush
methods.description: Posts a task to flush pending database operations in the background, executing a callback upon completion.

methods.name: Close
methods.description: Commits pending operations and closes the database, to be called before destruction.

methods.name: SetBeforeCommitCallback
methods.description: Sets a callback to be run before committing database changes.

methods.name: InitializeDatabase
methods.description: Initializes the database on a background thread, including schema migration and setup.

methods.name: RecordOpenDBProblem
methods.description: Records metrics related to database opening problems.

methods.name: RecordDBMigrationProblem
methods.description: Records metrics related to database migration issues.

methods.name: DoMigrateDatabaseSchema
methods.description: Pure virtual method for subclass to implement database schema migration logic.

methods.name: CreateDatabaseSchema
methods.description: Pure virtual method for subclass to create or verify database schema.

methods.name: DoInitializeDatabase
methods.description: Optional override for additional database initialization tasks.

methods.name: Reset
methods.description: Resets and resets the database, typically after errors.

methods.name: Commit
methods.description: Commits pending database operations, invoking pre-commit callback.

methods.name: DoCommit
methods.description: Pure virtual method for subclass to implement commit logic.

methods.name: PostBackgroundTask
methods.description: Posts a task to the background thread.

methods.name: PostClientTask
methods.description: Posts a task to the client thread.

methods.name: MigrateDatabaseSchema
methods.description: Handles database schema migration, returning success status.

methods.name: FlushAndNotifyInBackground
methods.description: Flushes pending operations on background thread and notifies callback.

methods.name: DoCloseInBackground
methods.description: Closes the database on background thread.

methods.name: DatabaseErrorCallback
methods.description: Handles database errors, potentially marking corruption and scheduling recovery.

methods.name: KillDatabase
methods.description: Terminates the database in case of catastrophic errors.
